name: CosyVoice 2
description: Alibaba FunAudioLLM multilingual zero-shot TTS server with real-time voice cloning. Accepts 3-5s reference audio to synthesize arbitrary speech in a cloned voice. Self-hosted via FastAPI (canonical) or gRPC; no authentication in any self-hosted deployment variant. CORS wildcard, 0.0.0.0 binding, GPU-backed inference.
auth_notes: Zero authentication in all self-hosted deployment variants. FastAPI server starts with CORS allow_origins=["*"], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"]. Production uvicorn mode binds to 0.0.0.0 by default. No API key, no token, no basic auth documented anywhere in canonical repo or any community fork. The managed Alibaba Cloud PAI-EAS service requires Bearer token auth, but that is the cloud control plane, not the self-hosted server process. No rate limiting, no request quotas, no IP allowlisting in default config.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Catches Gradio WebUI instances running on canonical port 50000 with default page title
Conjunctive: canonical port plus route name that appears in FastAPI /docs Swagger schema - high precision, low false-positive rate
Model identifier string surfaced in Swagger docs, API responses, and /openapi.json on CosyVoice2 deployments specifically; distinguishes v2 from v1
Catches Triton inference server deployments (ports 8000-8002) and community forks on port 8000
Community wrappers and SillyTavern/GPT-SoVITS-style integrations that front CosyVoice on port 9880 - the GPT-SoVITS default API port frequently reused in CosyVoice community stacks

known_vulns: No registered CVEs as of 2026-08-04. Auth-by-design absent across all self-hosted variants - this is the primary systemic risk, not a discrete CVE. Multipart audio upload parsing in /inference_zero_shot and /upload_prompt_audio is an unaudited attack surface (malformed WAV/MP3 could trigger ffmpeg/soundfile parser bugs). No input size limits documented on audio uploads. FastAPI auto-generated /docs and /openapi.json expose full API schema unauthenticated.
risk_notes: Critical unauth impact: Any exposed instance allows unauthenticated voice cloning via POST /inference_zero_shot with a 3-5 second WAV reference. Attacker provides arbitrary TTS text and a target speaker audio file; server returns synthesized clone. No logging, no consent mechanism, no watermarking in default config. GPU compute theft: no rate limiting means unlimited GPU inference against operator hardware at attacker direction. PII exposure: uploaded reference audio files (voice biometrics) may be stored server-side in predictable paths with no access controls. CORS wildcard enables cross-site request forgery-style abuse from malicious web pages running in victim browsers on the same network. Multipart audio upload endpoint (/inference_zero_shot, /upload_prompt_audio) is an unreviewed parser attack surface. Gradio WebUI queue (4 requests, 2 concurrent) provides minimal DoS resistance but no auth gating. gRPC port equally unauthenticated - accessible to any client with protobuf definitions (published in repo). Realistic attacker chains: (1) enumerate open port 50000, verify /docs returns 200, POST synthesized CFO voice audio for vishing; (2) script bulk inference for TTS-as-a-service abuse against operator GPU; (3) exfiltrate previously uploaded reference audio files from server filesystem if path traversal present in audio handling.
deployment_notes: Canonical stack: Python FastAPI + uvicorn on port 50000, or gRPC server on same port, or Gradio WebUI on 50000. GPU (NVIDIA CUDA) required for production; Docker images use --runtime=nvidia. Model loaded from ModelScope (iic/CosyVoice2-0.5B, iic/CosyVoice-300M) or HuggingFace (FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice2-0.5B) on first run. TensorRT-LLM/Triton variant (soar97/triton-cosyvoice) uses ports 8000 (HTTP), 8001 (gRPC), 8002 (metrics). Community wrappers add OpenAI-compat /v1/audio/speech endpoints on varied ports (8012, 8188, 9880). Some community stacks (neosun/cosyvoice-docker v3.4.0) expose Swagger UI at /docs. Port 9880 seen in SillyTavern integrations and community deployments that mirror GPT-SoVITS API layout. No TLS in default configuration - all traffic plaintext HTTP. Jetson/ARM deployments (uglybaa/cosyvoice) use --network=host, eliminating port isolation.
